sections.title: بابِ چہارم — متن (۲)

paras.text: … remembered by the name “Objectives Resolution”. Through this resolution the Constituent Assembly, as the representative of the Pakistani people, affirmed that the future constitution of Pakistan would be in harmony with the teachings of the Qur’an and Sunnah. The people of Pakistan and their representatives will use their governmental powers within the limits fixed by Allah the Exalted.
paras.urdu: … نام سے یاد کیا جاتا ہے۔ اس قرارداد کے ذریعے دستور ساز اسمبلی نے پاکستانی عوام کے نمائندہ کی حیثیت سے یہ اقرار کیا کہ پاکستان کا آئندہ دستور قرآن و سنت کی تعلیمات سے ہم آہنگ ہوگا۔ پاکستان کے عوام اور ان کے نمائندے اپنے حکومتی اختیارات اللہ تعالیٰ کی مقرر کردہ حدود کے اندر رہ کر استعمال کریں گے۔
paras.pashto: … نوم یادېږي. د دې پرېکړه‌لیک له لارې اساسي قانون جوړوونکې اسمبلۍ د پاکستاني خلکو د استازي په توګه اقرار وکړ چې د پاکستان راتلونکی اساسي قانون به د قرآن او سنت له لارښوونو سره همغږی وي. د پاکستان خلک او د هغوی استازي به خپل حکومتي واکونه د الله تعالیٰ په ټاکلو پولو کې دننه کاروي.

paras.text: 1. The concept of sovereignty
paras.urdu: 1۔ حاکمیتِ اعلیٰ کا تصور
paras.pashto: ۱. د لوړ حاکمیت تصور

paras.text: Sovereignty over the whole universe belongs to Allah the Exalted alone. He has no partner in sovereignty. paras.text: 2. Following the basic principles of Islam
paras.urdu: 2۔ اسلام کے بنیادی اصولوں کی پیروی
paras.pashto: ۲. د اسلام د بنسټیزو اصولو پیروي

paras.pashto: دولت به خپل واک او اختیارات د خلکو د ټاکل شویو استازو له لارې کاروي، چې پکې به د ډیموکراسۍ، ازادۍ، برابرۍ، زغم او ټولنیز انصاف پر اصولو د اسلامي لارښوونو سره سم عمل کېږي.

paras.text: 3. Promotion of Islamic teachings in individual and collective life

paras.text: The state will enable Muslims to lead their individual and collective lives according to Islamic teachings.

paras.text: 5. Protection of fundamental rights

paras.pashto: ۵. د بنسټیزو حقونو ساتنه

sections.theory:
… remembered by the name “Objectives Resolution”. Through this resolution the Constituent Assembly, as the representative of the Pakistani people, affirmed that the future constitution of Pakistan would be in harmony with the teachings of the Qur’an and Sunnah. The people of Pakistan and their representatives will use their governmental powers within the limits fixed by Allah the Exalted.

Salient points of the Objectives Resolution

The Objectives Resolution apparently looks like a formal constitutional declaration, but this resolution, by providing a solid foundation for constitution-making in Pakistan, became the cause of clear progress in this respect. The special points of the resolution are as follows.

1. The concept of sovereignty

Sovereignty over the whole universe belongs to Allah the Exalted alone. He has no partner in sovereignty. The authority of sovereignty with the inhabitants of Pakistan has the status of a sacred trust, and they are bound to exercise these powers while remaining within the limits of the Qur’an and Sunnah.

2. Following the basic principles of Islam

The state will exercise its power and authority through the elected representatives of the people, in which democracy, freedom, equality, tolerance and the principles of social justice will be acted upon according to Islamic teachings.

3. Promotion of Islamic teachings in individual and collective life

The state will enable Muslims to lead their individual and collective lives according to Islamic teachings.

4. Protection of the rights of minorities

Minorities will have complete freedom to practise their religion and to preach it. Moreover they will also be free to develop their culture and protect their legitimate interests.

5. Protection of fundamental rights

Citizens will have protection of all fundamental rights, e.g. freedom, equality, property, expression of opinion, belief, worship and association, and they will not be deprived of these rights.

6. Federal form of government and provincial autonomy

The units included in Pakistan will form a federation in which the units (provinces) will have autonomy.

7. Independence of the judiciary

In the constitution the independence of the judiciary will have complete protection, i.e. no governmental or non-governmental pressure of any kind will be put on it in making decisions.

After the approval of this resolution, a Basic Principles Committee for framing the country’s constitution was also formed on the same day, and to advise this committee on Islamic teachings a Board of Islamic Teachings was also formed. Maulana Syed Sulaiman Nadvi was appointed chairman of this board.

قراردادِ مقاصد بظاہر ایک رسمی آئینی اعلان نظر آتی ہے مگر یہ قرارداد پاکستان میں دستور سازی کو ایک ٹھوس بنیاد فراہم کر کے اس ضمن میں واضح پیش رفت کا باعث بنی۔ قرارداد کے خاص خاص نکات مندرجہ ذیل ہیں۔

1۔ حاکمیتِ اعلیٰ کا تصور

پوری کائنات میں حاکمیتِ اعلیٰ صرف اللہ تعالیٰ کو حاصل ہے۔ حاکمیت میں اس کا کوئی شریک نہیں۔ پاکستان کے باشندوں کے پاس حاکمیت کا اختیار ایک مقدس امانت کی حیثیت رکھتا ہے اور وہ اس بات کے پابند ہیں کہ قرآن و سنت کی حدود میں رہتے ہوئے ان اختیارات کو بروئے کار لائیں۔

2۔ اسلام کے بنیادی اصولوں کی پیروی

ریاست اپنے اقتدار اور اختیارات کا استعمال عوام کے منتخب نمائندوں کے ذریعے کرے گی جس میں جمہوریت، آزادی، مساوات، رواداری اور معاشرتی انصاف کے اصولوں پر اسلامی تعلیمات کے مطابق عمل کیا جائے گا۔

3۔ انفرادی اور اجتماعی زندگی میں اسلامی تعلیمات کا فروغ

ریاست مسلمانوں کو اس قابل بنائے گی کہ وہ اپنی انفرادی اور اجتماعی زندگی اسلامی تعلیمات کے مطابق بسر کر سکیں۔

اقلیتوں کو اپنے مذہب پر عمل کرنے اور اس کی تبلیغ کرنے کی مکمل آزادی حاصل ہوگی۔ نیز وہ اپنے تمدن کی نشو و نما اور جائز مفادات کے تحفظ میں بھی آزاد ہوں گے۔

… remembered by the name “Objectives Resolution”. Through this resolution the Constituent Assembly, as the representative of the Pakistani people, affirmed that the future constitution of Pakistan would be in harmony with the teachings of the Qur’an and Sunnah. The people of Pakistan and their representatives will use their governmental powers within the limits fixed by Allah the Exalted.

Salient points of the Objectives Resolution

The Objectives Resolution apparently looks like a formal constitutional declaration, but this resolution, by providing a solid foundation for constitution-making in Pakistan, became the cause of clear progress in this respect. The special points of the resolution are as follows.

1. The concept of sovereignty

Sovereignty over the whole universe belongs to Allah the Exalted alone. He has no partner in sovereignty. The authority of sovereignty with the inhabitants of Pakistan has the status of a sacred trust, and they are bound to exercise these powers while remaining within the limits of the Qur’an and Sunnah.

2. Following the basic principles of Islam

The state will exercise its power and authority through the elected representatives of the people, in which democracy, freedom, equality, tolerance and the principles of social justice will be acted upon according to Islamic teachings.

3. Promotion of Islamic teachings in individual and collective life

The state will enable Muslims to lead their individual and collective lives according to Islamic teachings.

4. Protection of the rights of minorities

Minorities will have complete freedom to practise their religion and to preach it. Moreover they will also be free to develop their culture and protect their legitimate interests.

5. Protection of fundamental rights

Citizens will have protection of all fundamental rights, e.g. freedom, equality, property, expression of opinion, belief, worship and association, and they will not be deprived of these rights.

6. Federal form of government and provincial autonomy

The units included in Pakistan will form a federation in which the units (provinces) will have autonomy.

7. Independence of the judiciary

In the constitution the independence of the judiciary will have complete protection, i.e. no governmental or non-governmental pressure of any kind will be put on it in making decisions.

After the approval of this resolution, a Basic Principles Committee for framing the country’s constitution was also formed on the same day, and to advise this committee on Islamic teachings a Board of Islamic Teachings was also formed. Maulana Syed Sulaiman Nadvi was appointed chairman of this board.

Importance of the Objectives Resolution

The Objectives Resolution has special importance in the history of constitution-making in Pakistan. This resolution ended the ongoing controversial debate in the country regarding the form and character of the constitution and made it clear that Pakistan’s …
